verdict.rationale: Postman docs mention Postman Vault as a way to secure secrets/data (postman-docs-15), which supports masking credentials from shared files, but there is no evidence in the pack of external vault integrations (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager) or details on masking behavior, secret scanning, or enterprise-grade credential governance. Community evidence even raises concerns about secrets being uploaded to Postman's servers (postman-comm-12), which adds a caveat rather than a concrete contradiction of the masking claim itself. missing for 10: documentation on third-party/external vault integrations, details on secret masking implementation, independent verification that shared collections/environments never expose raw secrets.
